options.why: Uses the temperature change $30 - 12 = 18$ without dividing by the elapsed time.
Divides the final temperature by the elapsed time, $30 \div 6 = 5$, without subtracting the initial temperature.
Reverses the temperature subtraction but keeps the time subtraction unchanged: $(12 - 30) \div 6 = -3$.
Calculates the rise $21 - 5 = 16$ but forgets to divide by the run $6 - 2 = 4$.
Inverts the gradient formula by computing run over rise ($\frac{4}{16} = 0.25$).
Averages the $x$- and $y$-coordinates of $A$ only, $(2 + 5) \div 2 = 3.5$, instead of finding the gradient.
Calculates the total mass change $80 - 20 = 60\text{ mg}$ without dividing by the elapsed time of $5\text{ hours}$.
Divides the final mass by the final time, $80 \div 7 \approx 11.43\text{ mg/h}$ to $2$ decimal places, instead of using the changes in mass and time.
Divides initial mass $20$ by $2\text{ hours}$ ($20 \div 2 = 10\text{ mg/h}$) instead of finding average rate over $[2, 7]$.
Uses the distance change $43 - 8 = 35$ without dividing by the elapsed time.
Divides the distance change by the final time instead of the elapsed time: $35 \div 7 = 5$.
Reverses the distance subtraction but keeps the time subtraction unchanged: $(8 - 43) \div (7 - 2) = -7$.
Uses the volume change $24 - 60 = -36$ without dividing by the elapsed time.
Divides the volume change by the final time instead of the elapsed time: $-36 \div 4 = -9$.
Reverses the volume subtraction while keeping the time subtraction unchanged: $(60 - 24) \div (4 - 1) = 12$.
Calculates the total vertical drop $5 - 45 = -40\text{ m}$ but omits dividing by $\Delta t = 2\text{ s}$.
Omits the negative sign, ignoring that height is decreasing as the object falls.
Adds the endpoint times, $1 + 3 = 4$, instead of subtracting them, giving $-40 \div 4 = -10\text{ m/s}$.
Gives the total change in water level $18 - 34 = -16\text{ m}$ without dividing by $8\text{ days}$.
Gives a positive rate of change even though the water level is decreasing.
Negates the final level and divides by the elapsed time, $-18 \div 8 = -2.25\text{ m/day}$, instead of using the change in level.
Uses the temperature change $23.4 - 8.6 = 14.8$ without dividing by the elapsed time.
Divides the temperature change by the final time, $14.8 \div 4.7 \approx 3.15$, to $2$ decimal places, instead of using the elapsed time.
Adds the endpoint times instead of subtracting them: $14.8 \div (1.2 + 4.7) \approx 2.51$, to $2$ decimal places.
